purpose: The frameworks of the house. Descriptive: a framework's conformance is what its own CI measures with `estatuto gate`, not what this file says.

frameworks.name: La Generala
frameworks.charter: A governance runtime for AI-assisted work: it turns an assignment into a graph of obligations, executes it durably with the employees a tenant has authorised, and refuses to declare work finished until independent assurance, provenance and the exact context used are on record.

frameworks.name: El Corresponsal
frameworks.charter: Governed web research and browser operation: typed assignments, explicit authority and budget, evidence-first results with literal citations; it never accepts its own work.

frameworks.name: La Bibliotecaria
frameworks.charter: Autonomous, continuous contextual memory: it preserves originals, extracts structure and meaning, catalogues, relates and historicises information, and delivers citable, authorised context to agents; it never delivers a final answer.
